serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.Happy
You: Are you ready to go bowling?
Bot: Yes! I calibrated my sensors and actuators so I can assure victory!
You: You seem awfully excited. Did you forget that Melissa will be there?
Bot: Hmph! I know she will be there, you don’t need to remind me, but there also will be Annalie! 
You: So you like Annalie more than you dislike Melissa?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.angry
Bot: If I were to put a numeric value to both, that wouldn’t be the case.
You: Then why?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: I have other objectives than just having fun. I’m going there to absolutely crush Melissa at bowling.
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Sounds good to me, but please let it be a healthy competition. No shouting!
Bot: Sure, sure, stop nagging.
Is she entering her rebellious phase? I can’t even imagine how disastrous that would be…
